defmodule SearchIndexer.Auth do
  @moduledoc """
  NTLM authentication module for the search indexing service.
  Handles NTLM challenge-response authentication with role-based access control.
  """

  require Logger

  defstruct [:username, :domain, :role, :session_id, :authenticated, :ntlm_hash]

  @roles %{
    "admin" => [:read, :write, :delete, :reindex, :manage_users],
    "indexer" => [:read, :write, :reindex],
    "reader" => [:read]
  }

  @session_timeout_ms 900_000

  def negotiate(conn, %{"authorization" => "NTLM " <> negotiate_msg}) do
    case decode_negotiate(negotiate_msg) do
      {:ok, flags} ->
        challenge = generate_challenge(flags)
        {:challenge, conn, challenge}
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warning("NTLM negotiate failed: #{reason}")
        {:error, :invalid_negotiate}
    end
  end

  def authenticate(conn, %{"authorization" => "NTLM " <> auth_msg}, challenge_state) do
    case decode_authenticate(auth_msg) do
      {:ok, %{username: username, domain: domain, response: response, lm_response: lm_resp}} ->
        validate_ntlm_response(conn, username, domain, response, lm_resp, challenge_state)
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warning("NTLM auth decode failed: #{reason}")
        {:error, :invalid_auth_message}
    end
  end

  defp validate_ntlm_response(conn, username, domain, nt_response, _lm_response, challenge_state) do
    with {:ok, stored_hash} <- lookup_user_hash(username, domain),
         :ok <- verify_response(nt_response, stored_hash, challenge_state.server_challenge) do
      role = get_user_role(username, domain)
      session = create_session(username, domain, role)
      {:ok, conn, session}
    else
      {:error, :user_not_found} ->
        Logger.warning("Authentication failed: user #{username}@#{domain} not found")
        {:error, :authentication_failed}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  def authorize(session, action) do
    permissions = Map.get(@roles, session.role, [])
    if action in permissions do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :forbidden}
    end
  end

  defp generate_challenge(flags) do
    server_challenge = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(8)
    %{
      server_challenge: server_challenge,
      flags: flags,
      timestamp: System.system_time(:millisecond)
    }
  end

  defp create_session(username, domain, role) do
    %__MODULE__{
      username: username,
      domain: domain,
      role: role,
      session_id: Base.encode64(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)),
      authenticated: true,
      ntlm_hash: nil
    }
  end

  defp decode_negotiate(msg) do
    case Base.decode64(msg) do
      {:ok, <<"NTLMSSP\0", 1::little-32, flags::little-32, _rest::binary>>} ->
        {:ok, flags}
      _ ->
        {:error, :malformed_negotiate}
    end
  end

  defp decode_authenticate(msg) do
    case Base.decode64(msg) do
      {:ok, <<"NTLMSSP\0", 3::little-32, rest::binary>>} ->
        parse_auth_fields(rest)
      _ ->
        {:error, :malformed_authenticate}
    end
  end

  defp parse_auth_fields(data) do
    # Simplified NTLM Type 3 message parsing
    try do
      <<lm_len::little-16, _lm_max::little-16, lm_offset::little-32,
        nt_len::little-16, _nt_max::little-16, nt_offset::little-32,
        domain_len::little-16, _domain_max::little-16, domain_offset::little-32,
        user_len::little-16, _user_max::little-16, user_offset::little-32,
        _rest::binary>> = data

      full_msg = <<"NTLMSSP\0", 3::little-32>> <> data
      lm_response = binary_part(full_msg, lm_offset, lm_len)
      nt_response = binary_part(full_msg, nt_offset, nt_len)
      domain = binary_part(full_msg, domain_offset, domain_len)
      username = binary_part(full_msg, user_offset, user_len)

      {:ok, %{
        username: decode_utf16(username),
        domain: decode_utf16(domain),
        response: nt_response,
        lm_response: lm_response
      }}
    rescue
      _ -> {:error, :parse_failed}
    end
  end

  defp decode_utf16(data), do: :unicode.characters_to_binary(data, {:utf16, :little})

  defp lookup_user_hash(username, domain) do
    case SearchIndexer.UserStore.get_hash(username, domain) do
      nil -> {:error, :user_not_found}
      hash -> {:ok, hash}
    end
  end

  defp get_user_role(username, domain) do
    SearchIndexer.UserStore.get_role(username, domain) || "reader"
  end

  defp verify_response(nt_response, stored_hash, server_challenge) do
    expected = compute_nt_response(stored_hash, server_challenge)
    if :crypto.hash_equals(expected, nt_response) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_credentials}
    end
  end

  defp compute_nt_response(nt_hash, challenge) do
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :md5, nt_hash, challenge)
  end
end

defmodule SearchIndexer.IndexController do
  require Logger
  alias SearchIndexer.Auth

  def reindex(conn, params, session) do
    with :ok <- Auth.authorize(session, :reindex) do
      index_name = params["index"]
      Logger.info("User #{session.username} triggering reindex on #{index_name}")
      SearchIndexer.Engine.reindex(index_name)
      {:ok, %{status: "reindex_started", index: index_name}}
    end
  end

  def search(conn, params, session) do
    with :ok <- Auth.authorize(session, :read) do
      query = params["q"]
      index = params["index"] || "default"
      results = SearchIndexer.Engine.search(index, query)
      {:ok, results}
    end
  end
end
